verdict.rationale: Docs and runtime probes show a clear remember→recall pipeline: `.remember` ingests conversational data (including session-scoped caching for fast recall), `.recall` performs semantic/classified search across memory, and `.improve` explicitly bridges short-term session memory into permanent memory for cross-session persistence. A runtime probe confirms this actually works end-to-end locally (cognee-cli demo loading a graph and answering recall queries) rather than being purely aspirational. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or hands-on evidence of semantic search *quality/accuracy* over real multi-session conversational data, and the one community mention found addresses setup friction rather than recall quality itself.
